competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease the Attack Bar by 30% with a 50% chance.
Attacks all enemies to remove all beneficial effects granted on them and to increase the chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns with a 75% chance each.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)

The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: When enemies or allies remove harmful effects, the Attack Bar of all allies will be increased by 20%. When enemies remove beneficial effects of allies, all harmful effects on the ally with removed beneficial effects will be removed and the Attack Bar will be increased by 20%. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
